subject.title: fix(memory-core): honor private-network settings for OpenAI-compatible embeddings

question: Should configured OpenAI-compatible memory embeddings follow provider transport's three-state private-network contract, including explicit false removing exact-host trust?
rationale: The implementation is correct and well-proven, but this user-visible upgrade and SSRF policy choice requires human authorization.

options.title: Approve shared provider policy
options.body: Adopt omitted exact-host trust, explicit-false denial, and explicit-true broader private-network access consistently across both surfaces.

options.title: Special-case memory compatibility
options.body: Preserve exact-host trust under explicit false for embeddings, intentionally diverging from provider transport.

options.title: Pause private endpoint support
options.body: Do not extend provider private-network policy to memory embeddings until another contract is selected.
